title: Grafana docs style: 'for example,' / 'Refer to [' / 'self-managed'
answers: What phrasing should docs use instead of 'e.g.' or 'see ['?
Grafana documentation style guide wording conventions
Should I write 'self-hosted' or 'self-managed' in Grafana docs?
body: Local convention: Grafana docs quarterly reviews consistently replace 'e.g.,' with 'for example,', 'See [link]' with 'Refer to [link]' (for cross-references to other docs sections), and 'self-hosted' with 'self-managed' when describing non-Cloud Grafana deployments. Apply these substitutions when editing or reviewing docs prose, not just in Azure Monitor pages.
